mentions.name: Chobble Tickets
mentions.description: Open source event ticket sales platform licensed under AGPLv3 that runs on Deno edge script hosts like Bunny CDN, making it very affordable (around $1/month) and simple to self-host. It has no branding requirements and supports connecting your own domain. It is operated as a UK Community Interest Company with an asset lock so the product cannot be sold off. Six months into development, it hosts about 50 sites (charged at £5/month) and has processed a few thousand bookings.
mentions.problem: There are lots of open source ticket sales options but none fit the criteria of a full copyleft license, no branding requirements, connecting your own domain, and very easy hosting.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm a former Bandcamp dev and current anarchist and have made an open source event ticket sales platform called Chobble Tickets which runs on Deno edge script hosts like Bunny CDN so is very affordable and simple to self host ($1/month ish)
mentions.author: chobbledotcom
